quote: "The sun — a light that, for want of a better word, I can only call yellow."
question: Two years, two hundred canvases, one head that would not stop burning. What does the field wear, and what does the fever?
why_en: Immortelle is the field: bergamot and lemon give one bright second, then immortelle takes the heart entirely — honeyed, dry, no shade anywhere in it. Papyrus and vetiver close it like stalks after the harvest.
why_ar: وبوتيه دو ديابل هي الحمّى: أفسنتينٌ وجِنٌ وبرتقالٌ مُرّ، ثم سروٌ وقرنفل — أخضرُ حادّ، كأشجار السرو التي لم يكفّ عن رسمها.
